Nicolás Sánchez-Fuenzalida successfully defended his PhD thesis on June 5, well done!
Lola Beerendonk successfully defended her PhD thesis on May 28, well done!
Samuel Noorman successfully defended his PhD thesis on April 8, well done!
Stijn Nuijten successfully defended his PhD thesis on Sept 4, well done!

The Open Science Award of the Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences at the Free University Amsterdam was given out for developing the ADAM toolbox , a freely available software toolbox to perform multivariate analysis of EEG data. Thanks selection committee!
Simon was interviewed by Dutch Newspaper "Het Parool" about the relationship between stress and performance as highlighted in Lola's PNAS paper .
Johannes was interviewed about hypnosis for kids science TV show "Proefkonijnen" (guinea pigs). You can watch the English subtitled fragment here or the full episode here .
This year we had not one but two PNAS publications. Very proud of Nico and Lola who did all the hard work on these projects.
We are h appy to be able to consolidate our work on the neural mechanisms of consciousness! The project starts in September 2023
We are thankful that the Templeton Foundation funds developing a valid statistical framework for establishing unconscious cognition .
